description: High-performance mechanical keyboard with RGB backlighting, custom switches, and aluminum chassis.
Reduces wrist strain with 57-degree natural handshake angle and dual-device Bluetooth connectivity.
3440x1440 curved OLED display, 240Hz refresh rate, 0.03ms response time, HDR1000 certified.
Active noise cancellation with 40-hour battery life, spatial audio, and high-res lossless support.
Permanent single-user license for Markpad Native text and code utility by Vodiy.
Dual 4K 60Hz display support, 96W Power Delivery, SD card reader, 2.5Gb Ethernet.
